crossRefs.note: After these things, Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, asked of Pilate…

parallels.note: This man went to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body. Then Pilate commanded the body to be given up.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

people.name: Pilate
people.line: Roman governor who presided over Jesus' trial
